quoted_instead.definition: CREATE TRIGGER quoted_instead INSTEAD OF DELETE ON public."Order" FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE PROCEDURE public."fn_X"('it''s', 'a,b');

truncate_row.definition: CREATE TRIGGER truncate_row AFTER TRUNCATE ON public."Order" FOR EACH ROW WHEN (("a)") = ')') EXECUTE FUNCTION fn_trunc()

multi.definition: CREATE TRIGGER multi BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF "Order", a OR DELETE ON public."Order" FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.fn_multi()

bare.definition: CREATE TRIGGER bare AFTER INSERT ON public."Order" EXECUTE FUNCTION fn_bare()

escaped_ident.definition: CREATE TRIGGER escaped_ident BEFORE UPDATE OF "a""b", fn$1 ON public."Order" EXECUTE FUNCTION public."fn""x"()

constraint_touch.definition: CREATE CONSTRAINT TRIGGER constraint_touch AFTER UPDATE ON public."Order" FROM public.accounts DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED REFERENCING OLD TABLE AS old_rows NEW TABLE new_rows FOR EACH ROW WHEN (id IS NOT NULL) EXECUTE FUNCTION fn_touch()
